name: BounceBan
summary: Email verification that also scores catch-all and gateway-protected addresses, with single, bulk-list and account calls.

api_key.description: a BounceBan API key (API settings in your BounceBan dashboard)

notes: The Authorization header carries the bare key, with no 'Bearer' prefix.
Each single or bulk verification costs 1 credit; credits for unknown results are refunded (bulk, at task end). /v1/check bills a separate Check Plan balance.
A key can have daily and monthly quotas; going over one answers 403 with error api_key_quota_exceeded and quota_resets_at.
Single verification waits up to 15 seconds, then answers status 'verifying' with an id; poll bounceban.single.status for it. Never resubmit while verifying, every request is billed.

Bulk flow: create a task from a JSON list (bounceban.bulk.create, up to about 500,000 emails), poll bounceban.bulk.status until status is finished, then read results with bounceban.bulk.dump (JSON, cursor-paged) or bounceban.bulk.export (a CSV download link valid 4 hours). CSV file upload (multipart) and the waterfall host api-waterfall.bounceban.com are not in this entry.
Results are kept for 90 days. Rate limits are per account, e.g. 25 per second for single verify, 3 per second for bulk create, 5 per second for account.

endpoints.name: Verify one email
endpoints.summary: Deliverable, risky, undeliverable or unknown, with a 0-100 score and accept-all, role, free and disposable flags.

mode.description: regular (default), or deepverify to assume the domain is the owner's current company site.

url.description: Webhook URL that receives the result by POST.

disable_catchall_verify.description: 1 to run only basic SMTP checks; catch-all addresses then return unknown, score -1, at no cost.

notes: A read: costs 1 credit per request, even for the same email. If status is 'verifying', poll bounceban.single.status with the returned id.

endpoints.name: Get a single verification's result
endpoints.summary: Fetch the result of an earlier single verification by id, free of charge.

id.description: The id returned by a single verification.

notes: Free. Keep to 10 polls per id per 5 minutes; after 5 minutes without a result, start a new verification.

endpoints.name: Check an email or domain without SMTP
endpoints.summary: Syntax validity, work/free/disposable domain type and personal/role username type.

email.description: Email to check; wins over domain if both are sent.

notes: Send at least one of email or domain. Costs 1 Check Plan credit, not a verification credit.

endpoints.name: Get credits and rate limits
endpoints.summary: Credit balance (-1 means unlimited), owner email and per-endpoint rate limits.

endpoints.name: Start a bulk verification from a list
endpoints.summary: Submits a list of emails as an asynchronous task and returns its id.

emails.description: Emails to verify; about 500,000 per task at most.

url.description: Webhook URL, one POST per verified email.

url_finished.description: Webhook URL called once when the task finishes.

mode.description: regular (default) or deepverify, for every email.

greylisting_bypass.description: auto (default), speed (about 1 minute retry delay, more risky flags) or robust (about 5 minutes, fewer risky flags).

disable_catchall_verify.description: 1 makes catch-all addresses unknown, score -1, free.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a job that only produces data, and bills 1 credit per email. Returns {id, credits_remaining}; poll bounceban.bulk.status with the id.
The whole task is rejected with 403 if credits or the key's quota cannot cover it.

endpoints.name: Get a bulk task's status
endpoints.summary: Task status (importing, verifying, finished), progress counts and, when finished, result counts and credits used.

endpoints.name: Page through a bulk task's results
endpoints.summary: Per-email results as JSON, also while the task is still running.

state.description: Only this result; omit for all verified emails so far.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page; repeat until it comes back null.

retrieve_all.description: 1 returns everything at once, only for tasks of 20,000 emails or fewer; ignores cursor and page_size.

endpoints.name: Get bulk results for specific emails
endpoints.summary: Results for up to 100 named emails from one finished task.

emails.description: Up to 100 emails, all from this task.

notes: A read over POST: it only looks results up. The answer has result 'err' if the task has not finished.

endpoints.name: Get a CSV download link for a finished task
endpoints.summary: A public CSV link, valid 4 hours, filtered by result type, score and email flags.

keep_all_rows.description: Keep source rows without an email (only for tasks made from a file).

criteria.description: Filters, all optional booleans: deliverable (default true), risky (false), risky_score (0-100, default 50), undeliverable (false), unknown (false), free (true), role (true), accept_all (true), disposable (false).

notes: A read over POST: it only builds a download link. Generation takes about 30 seconds per 100k emails; if download_url is not ready, retry after a few seconds (at most 15 requests per export per 15 minutes).

endpoints.name: Stop a bulk task
endpoints.summary: Stops a queued or verifying task; credits for unverified emails are refunded.
notes: Emails already in flight get up to 60 seconds to finish. Answers 400 if the task is importing or already finished.

endpoints.name: Delete a bulk task
endpoints.summary: Permanently removes a task and all its results.
